title: Positive exactness of injective topological Čech cochains
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $U_i$ any family of opens, and $I$ an injective abelian sheaf [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Its ordered Čech complex is exact in every degree $q+1$, for every $q\in\mathbf N$. No covering hypothesis or finiteness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Use the source library theorem exactAt_cechComplex_of_injective. Its proved argument embeds the presheaf in its Godement presheaf, splits that embedding by injectivity, and transports the explicit Godement Čech contraction through the splitting. This statement has no remaining proof hole.
